note: Keeps the boot-time idempotent DDL in the service and adds an applySchema retry for replica races; no Django migration is introduced.
Deletes the AccessControlledLemonMenu wrapper and cast; LemonButton now takes disabledReason from getAccessControlDisabledReason directly.
Renames _catalog_drop_reason to _catalog_refusal_reason at its definition and both call sites in runs.py.
Replaces the raw setTimeout plus beforeUnmount cleanup with a cache.disposables.add timer keyed replayVisionDwell, disposing it once fired.
Removes the copied warning-hog PNG and export; error fallback now loads a shared brand hoggie via hoggiePng. Other local hog assets remain.
Extracts a shared useCommentFocusRequest hook used by RightPanel, moves openSide to rightPanelSide, and uses useIsCloudTask in ChangesPanelContent.
Removes the fbc derivation from ingestion entirely (no more daily re-stamping) rather than moving the same-click decision to where person state is known.
Adds heatmap:read scope and defaults missing source_authentication to session in csv_exporter; does not import the shared function to remove the copy.
Extracts a shared FrameWarningIcon used by NoContext, Unsymbolicated and Unresolved icons; the two components still exist separately.
Makes seed watermarks only advance via Math.max; the local toEpochSeconds/bucket helpers are kept rather than replaced by an existing utility.
Adds an optional wrapTrigger prop to ActionButton and renders the File-to dropdown trigger through it, removing the hand-rolled Tooltip nest.
Announces sandbox start from the run response's starts_sandbox and price in SQLV2 logic only; legacy Python/DuckSQL/HogQLSQL kernel paths untouched.
Splits rejected metrics into enforced vs preexisting and records a not_evaluated cross-field stage; the write-source helper is not switched to get_event_source.
Switches is_email_verification_disabled from feature_enabled_or_false to get_feature_flag_or_none, treating only True as disabled.
Drops the claim foreign key from SignalReportAssignment, marks the model read-only legacy, and derives ownership from claim artefacts instead.
Only adds an info tooltip explaining project access levels; no logic is moved into a kea logic.
Adds _scope_from_counts helper turning rows and rerun_existing into a BackfillScope, used by both the heavy and non-heavy branches.
Moves reportFeatureFlagsBulkArchived into eventUsageLogic as a connected action; the bulk archive and copy summary functions are not merged.
Leaf child cost now read via extractTotalCost(child.event) with a null check instead of the raw property and typeof check.
Deletes ProcessLiveness, registers the Kafka producer in a HealthRegistry, and serves readiness from the registry status.
